meta.title: Meeting recorder
meta.description: Open a new tab in the session’s right sidebar and select Meeting recorder. Record the microphone, computer audio, or both. The Windows desktop app uses the default playback device, and the web app uses the browser sharing picker. Prepare a notebook with bold and colored text, bulleted or numbered lists, before recording. Once recording starts, the notes stay with the meeting and the transcript appears. Transcribe locally with SenseVoice in Chinese or auto-detect the language. The local CAM++ model groups voices within each audio source. Uncertain turns can be labeled by hand. Generate minutes from the transcript and notes. Open past meetings from history to rename, delete or reveal their files. Prepare the speech model in the panel on first use. Generating minutes sends the transcript and notes to the default DSH model. Meetings are saved in this browser.
